description:
Manage thread files under the vault's threads directory.

Subcommands:
  list [QUERY] [--all] [--json] — list thread files; open only by default
  show THREAD [--json] — show a single thread file
  new [--name NAME] [--kind project|process|topic] [--category professional|personal|voluntary] [--currency ISO] [--rate RATE] — create a thread file (INTERACTIVE for any field not supplied)
  delete THREAD [-y] — permanently delete a thread file (DESTRUCTIVE)

Flags:
  list: --all include paused and closed threads; --json JSON output. QUERY is an optional fuzzy search that ranks by similarity.
  show: --json JSON output. THREAD is a thread name or 'Kind/Name'.
  new: --name thread name; --kind one of project, process, topic; --category one of professional, personal, voluntary; --currency 3-letter ISO code, sets the default currency for `hours`; --rate default hourly rate, requires --currency.
  delete: -y skip the confirmation prompt.

Examples:
  ["list", "--json"]
  ["show", "Projects/SGB", "--json"]
  ["new", "--name", "SGB", "--kind", "project", "--category", "professional", "--currency", "ZAR", "--rate", "2500"]
  ["delete", "Topics/Old", "-y"]

Notes:
  `new` prompts on stdin for every field not passed as a flag. Always pass --name, --kind and --category together so it never prompts.
  `delete` prompts for confirmation unless -y is given; it removes the file permanently.
  A thread must exist before notes, buffer entries, hours or payments can reference it.
